description: Inspects a local project directory on disk (checking package.json, public/robots.txt, public/llms.txt, and public/.well-known/ai-catalog.json) and returns a Markdown compliance report with per-file pass/fail status, a 6-line /llms.txt preview, and remediation links. Use this tool only when auditing local source files inside an IDE workspace; do not use it to scan a live HTTPS website (use audit_ai_readiness instead) or to synthesize manifests from a remote domain (use generate_ai_manifests instead). If targetDir contains a public/ subfolder, discovery files are checked inside public/ first before falling back to targetDir root. Performs a 100% read-only local check with zero file writes, requires no API key, has no rate limit, and returns an error message if targetDir is unreadable.

includePreview.description: Optional flag (defaults to true). When true, appends a 6-line preview of the synthesized /llms.txt index derived from package.json metadata; when false, returns only the structural pass/fail checklist.

targetDir.description: Relative or absolute local workspace directory path to inspect (e.g., "./", ".", or "/workspace/app"). Must point to a readable project folder.

name: audit_local_codebase
title: Audit Local Codebase AI Readiness & Manifest Structure
